title: Water And Wine | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
meta_description: Water and Wine — a house in Watersound, Florida. 12 guests · 5 bedrooms · 5.5 bathrooms. Book direct with Stay on 30a.
description_expanded: Welcome to 'Water and Wine,' a coastal retreat designed for gathering, unwinding, and soaking in the best of 30A living. Perfectly situated within the private, gated community of WaterSound, this five-bedroom, 5.5-bath home sleeps up to 12 guests and offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm.From the moment you arrive, the relaxed elegance of Water and Wine invites you to slow down and truly embrace vacation mode. Mornings are best spent sipping coffee on the outdoor patio while the neighborhood wakes around you. By midday, you can choose your own adventure cool off in your private pool, take a quick ride to one of the beautiful WaterSound community pools, or hop on the bikes for a breezy trip to the private beach access just minutes away..Head up to the top level in the evening for a special treat of sweeping Gulf views that make sunset hour feel extra magical. Whether you’re enjoying a quiet drink, taking family photos, or simply letting the ocean breeze wash over you, it’s the perfect way to end the day.Exploring the area is effortless with eight adult bikes included with your stay. Ride over to The Big Chill, a lively gathering spot for dining, shopping, live music, and outdoor movies that’s perfect for guests of all ages. Beyond that, 30A’s scenic bike trails, charming beach towns, and world-class dining are all at your fingertips.Back at the house, evenings can be spent grilling and dining, swapping stories by the pool, or cozying up for a movie night. Every detail of Water and Wine is designed to make your stay feel easy, refreshing, and memorable whether you’re here for a week of family fun or a relaxing getaway with friends. With private beach access, a prime WaterSound location, and the perfect mix of private and community amenities, Water and Wine offers everything you need for a quintessential 30A vacation plus those Gulf views you’ll dream about long after you leave.HOME HIGHLIGHTSGated communityGulf views from crows nest with outdoor seatingPrivate heated pool *Pool heating available for an additional fee of $25 per dayAccess to private beach with optional chair service (additional charge direct to vendor)WiFi8 adult bikesFully stocked kitchenFull washer & dryerOutdoor seating/loungingOutdoor showerOutdoor built-in gas grillBeach gearSunroom with fireplaceOutdoor TVACCOMMODATIONSSleeps: 125 Bedrooms / 5.5 BathsFIRST FLOORBedroom #1: King Bed, with EnsuiteSECOND FLOORBedroom #2: Queen, with EnsuiteBedroom #3: King, with EnsuiteBedroom #4: King, with EnsuiteTHIRD FLOORBedroom #5: (2) Twin/Twin Bunk, with Jack/Jill BathroomWHAT WE OFFERA STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIESBody WashShampooConditionerHand SoapToilet PaperDish SoapDishwasher PodsLaundry DetergentPaper TowelsTrash BagsDish SpongeBath TowelsBed Linens |WELCOME BUNDLECoffee Grounds2 Keurig PodsPopcornOlive OilFiji WaterPARKINGTwo parking spaces available (2 driveway). No street parking allowed. **Additional vehicles will need to be parked off Watersound premises. Location can be provided by guest services.Included are 8 bicycles (adult) for your convenience.WATERSOUND COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTSOver 250 Acre Gated Beach Community on the Gulf of Mexico between Seaside and Rosemary Beach(2) Community PoolsParks, Walking Trails and Meandering BoardwalksBike to Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach and Rosemary BeachA short walk to The Big Chill (formerly The Hub)**Please Note:*Access to the WaterSound Beach Club is not included.*WaterSound does not allow golf cart rentals.HOUSE RULES*Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM*Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.*No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.*No parties or events.*During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi.*Private Heated Pool **Pool heating is available for an additional fee of $25/day. Must be heated for duration of stay. If selected, it must be requested 48 hours prior to check in and paid before the heater will be turned on.*Space must remain pet free!*There are no refunds for weather related events. We advise trip insurance during hurricane season (May-November)IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVALAll guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie".Other things to note
